key_insight: STAR reallocates a single image-level RL reward across time and space, focusing policy updates on the latent regions and denoising stages that most affect text-image alignment.
engineering_relevance: This makes RL post-training for diffusion and flow models more targeted and efficient, improving alignment and rendering quality without changing the external reward model.
method: Use text-image attention to identify core prompt-relevant content in the generation process.
Build spatial allocation maps that vary across denoising steps and rollouts.
Apply the same group-relative advantage with stronger weight to more relevant latent regions via a spatially resolved policy objective.
evidence_signal: Using Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium, STAR reports 0.9759 on GenEval, 0.9757 on OCR text rendering, and 23.60 on PickScore.
watch_item: The method depends on reliable attention-based relevance maps, which may be sensitive to prompt structure or model internals and could be harder to generalize across architectures.
paper_title: STAR: SpatioTemporal Adaptive Reward Allocation for Text-to-Image RL Post-Training
